title: Module with no toolchain directive
description: go.mod declares a go.mod that names no toolchain, so the local one decides. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a go.mod that names no toolchain, so the local one decides.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a go.mod that names no toolchain, so the local one decides.
limitation: It matches a go.mod that names no toolchain, so the local one decides in the parsed go.mod; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
